title: Why move state logic into a reducer

slides.say: A task app has add, change and delete handlers. Each one calls set tasks with its own logic.
As the component grows, state logic gets sprinkled across many handlers. It gets hard to see every way the state can change.

slides.text: A reducer puts all that logic in ONE function, outside the component.
slides.say: A reducer moves all that logic into one function, outside your component. One easy place to look.

slides.text: 3 steps: dispatch actions → write a reducer → useReducer.
slides.say: You migrate in three steps. Dispatch actions instead of setting state. Write a reducer function. Then use it with use reducer.
